title: geranium pallidum
intro: Geranium pallidum, commonly known as the pale geranium, is a species of flowering plant in the geranium family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is often used to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The health benefits of Geranium pallidum include its ability to regulate hormonal imbalances, improve mood, and reduce stress, which is attributed to its therapeutic actions such as sedation and anti-anxiety effects. The bioactive constituents of Geranium pallidum include geraniol, linalool, and beta-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
